en.title: Word Counter for Students: Hit Essay Word Limits
en.description: A word counter for students who write to a word limit: check essays as you write, see why totals differ between tools, and keep references out of the count.
en.lede: Essays, reports and applications come with a word limit. Paste your draft, watch the count as you cut, and submit with a margin instead of guessing.

problems.title: The limit is hard
problems.body: Assignments set a minimum or a maximum in words, and a few words over or under can cost marks. You need a number you can check as you write, not after you submit.

problems.title: Tools disagree
problems.body: Word processors, learning platforms and the checker your teacher uses can differ by a few words, because each has its own rules for hyphens and numbers. Knowing why helps you leave a margin.

problems.title: The reference list inflates the total
problems.body: Many courses leave the bibliography or long quotations out of the limit, so you need the count for the body text alone, not for the whole file.

workflow.title: Read the rule in the brief
workflow.body: Find out whether the limit includes headings, quotations, footnotes and the reference list, and whether it is a hard cap or a target with some tolerance.

workflow.title: Paste the body text only
workflow.body: Copy the part that counts into the word counter. Leave out the title page and the bibliography unless the brief says they count.

workflow.title: Cut with the number in view
workflow.body: Trim the weakest sentences and watch the count drop. Use the characters without spaces when a form counts letters instead of words.

workflow.title: Leave a margin and recheck
workflow.body: Stay a few words inside the limit, because the submission system may count differently, and check the final text once more after you format it.

examples.name: Word counter
examples.caption: Paste the body of your essay without the reference list and watch the word count change as you cut. Characters without spaces help when a form counts letters, and reading time helps when you are writing a talk.

examples.name: Math symbols
examples.caption: Copy plus-minus, not-equal, square root and other signs into a lab report or problem set without hunting through menus. Each symbol is plain text, so it pastes into most editors and documents.

examples.name: Check mark symbols
examples.caption: Copy a tick or a cross for a revision checklist or a study planner, so you can mark off topics in a plain-text note or a shared document without installing anything or opening another app.

faq: Does the reference list count towards my word limit?
It depends on the course. Many leave the bibliography out, but some include it. Read the assignment brief or ask your teacher, then paste only the part that counts.
Why does my submission system show a different number?
Each tool has its own rules for hyphens, numbers and symbols, so totals can differ by a few words. Stay a few words inside the limit to be safe.
Is my essay uploaded when I use the counter?
No. The counting happens in your browser tab, and nothing you type is sent to a server or saved.

zh.title: 学生字数统计工具：控制作业字数
zh.description: 写作业要控制字数的学生适用的字数统计工具：边写边核对作文字数，了解不同工具的总数为什么不同，并把参考文献排除在计数之外。
zh.lede: 作文、报告和申请材料都有字数限制。把草稿粘贴进来，一边删减一边看数字，留出余量再提交，而不是凭感觉估计。

problems.title: 限制是硬性的
problems.body: 作业会规定最少或最多多少字，多几个字或少几个字都可能扣分。你需要的是写作过程中就能核对的数字，而不是提交之后才发现。

problems.title: 各个工具数得不一样
problems.body: 文字处理软件、学习平台和老师使用的检查工具，可能相差几个词，因为每个工具对连字符和数字都有自己的规则。知道原因，就知道该留多少余量。

problems.title: 参考文献会抬高总数
problems.body: 许多课程不把参考文献或大段引文算进字数限制，所以你需要的是正文本身的字数，而不是整个文件的字数。

workflow.title: 先读清楚作业要求
workflow.body: 弄清楚限制是否包含标题、引文、脚注和参考文献，以及它是严格的上限，还是允许一定浮动的目标字数。

workflow.title: 只粘贴正文
workflow.body: 把需要计数的部分复制到字数统计工具里。除非要求里说明要算，否则不要放封面和参考文献。

workflow.title: 边删边看数字
workflow.body: 删掉最弱的句子，看着字数下降。表单按字母数量计算时，就看不含空格的字符数。

workflow.title: 留出余量，再核对一遍
workflow.body: 让字数比限制少几个词，因为提交系统的计数方式可能不同；排版完成后，再核对一次最终的文字。

examples.name: 字数统计
examples.caption: 把作文正文粘贴进来，不要放参考文献，一边删减一边看字数变化。表单按字母计数时可以看不含空格的字符数，准备演讲稿时可以看阅读时间。

examples.name: 数学符号
examples.caption: 把正负号、不等号、根号等符号复制到实验报告或习题里，不用在菜单中四处寻找。每个符号都是纯文本，可以粘贴到大多数编辑器和文档里。

examples.name: 对勾符号
examples.caption: 为复习清单或学习计划复制一个对勾或叉号，这样在纯文本笔记或共享文档里就能划掉已经复习完的主题，不需要安装任何东西，也不用打开别的应用。

faq: 参考文献算进字数限制吗？
这取决于课程。许多课程不算参考文献，但也有的要算。请看作业要求或询问老师，然后只粘贴需要计数的部分。
为什么提交系统显示的数字不一样？
每个工具对连字符、数字和符号都有自己的规则，所以总数可能差几个词。让字数比限制少几个词会更稳妥。
使用这个工具时，我的作文会被上传吗？
不会。统计在你的浏览器标签页里完成，你输入的内容不会发送到服务器，也不会被保存。
